subject.why: The atomizer hardware is missing its spray nozzle opposite the bulb, leaving no opening for perfume to actually spray out.

category.why: The bottle rests on a flat single-colour surface with a smoothly gradated wall behind it, using a contrasting bright green colour family.

clean.why: No text, watermarks, UI elements, or characters are present.

framing.why: The perfume bottle is centrally framed with ample, well-balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: The pink and gold bottle pops distinctly against the bright, saturated green background.

detail.why: The facets and tassel have clean, simplified geometry without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: The object features smooth, chunky volumes, a soft satin sheen on the gold and tassel, and no harsh outlines.

fix: Add a classic spray nozzle to the gold hardware on the side opposite the atomizer bulb.
